protocol.availabilityRule: One day after the printed PDF generation date. Proxy only, not first-seen publication evidence.
protocol.selectionRule: Latest captured current-quarter observation available by the fixed cutoff; final quarter outcomes excluded.
protocol.baselineRule: Compare both unchanged prior-year total and a seasonal-profile forecast: current QTD * prior-year full-quarter / prior-year QTD on the same calendar date.
protocol.sampleRule: Eight preselected NTPC thermal stations. No whole-company or stock-return inference.
